# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260921-1305-mcdonalds-validation`
- Research system: `ChatGPT Deep Research`
- Started at: `2026-09-21 13:05 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-21 13:07 CDT`
- Research scope: Validate four unresolved Coates Group pages associated with McDonald's.
- Queue item or vendor: `company:brand-mcdonald-s`
- Methodology: Direct vendor-page validation with product, geographic-scope, recency, and deployment checks.

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 3
- Conflicts found: 0
- Material takeaway: A June 2026 Coates page provides strong current evidence that Coates is a McDonald's China supplier supporting signage solutions at regional scale. A 2019 Japan page supports product-specific event-display evidence for indoor digital menu boards, community notice boards, and Switchboard, but not installed use. Two older convention pages corroborate a long-standing McDonald's relationship, especially in Australia, without establishing specific deployments.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: McDonald's China
- Vendor: Coates Group
- Product or category: Signage solutions; sourcing, signage design, customer service, quality, and support
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: regional
- Evidence type: other — supplier award / vendor news
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: The June 2026 vendor page reports McDonald's China's 2025 Best Supplier Award, describes Coates as a global McDonald's partner for more than 50 years, and says the 90-plus-person China team helps deliver signage solutions at scale. The relationship is current and region-specific, although the page does not enumerate installed products.
- Source title: Coates Group Receives McDonald's China's Highest Supplier Recognition
- Source URL: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-group-receives-mcdonalds-chinas-highest-supplier-recognition
- Publisher or source owner: Coates Group
- Published date, if known: 2026-06-23
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Coates reports receiving McDonald's China's top supplier award for 2025 after an earlier 2023 award and describes a long-term global partnership serving multiple markets.
- Product-specific evidence: The page identifies signage design and signage-product functions and says the China operation delivers signage solutions at scale; it does not specify digital menu boards, kiosks, or exact location counts.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-authored award coverage; current supplier status is strong, but the exact product estate and enterprise coverage remain unspecified.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a McDonald's China-controlled supplier announcement or a current Coates China case study that names installed products and rollout scope.

### Observation 2

- Brand: McDonald's Japan
- Vendor: Coates Group
- Product or category: Indoor digital menu boards, community notice boards, and Switchboard
- Relationship indication: partner
- Deployment scope: historical
- Evidence type: other — event recap
- Confidence: 55%
- Confidence rationale: The vendor page says Coates's Japan team displayed named products at McDonald's Japan's January 2019 Kick Off Meeting. That supports a product-specific working relationship or demonstration, not a live restaurant deployment.
- Source title: McDonald's Kick Off Meeting 2019
- Source URL: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/mcdonalds-kick-off-meeting-2019
- Publisher or source owner: Coates Group
- Published date, if known: 2019-03-25
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Coates reports participating in the McDonald's Japan event and displaying indoor digital menu boards, community notice boards, and a Switchboard question-and-answer booth.
- Product-specific evidence: Named event-display products are indoor digital menu boards, community notice boards, and Switchboard.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: No claim of installation, purchase, customer rollout, location count, or continued use after 2019.
- Recommended follow-up: Find a current Japan case study, award, installation reference, or McDonald's-controlled source before classifying any product as deployed.

### Observation 3

- Brand: McDonald's Australia
- Vendor: Coates Group
- Product or category: Unspecified QSR technology / signage partnership
- Relationship indication: partner
- Deployment scope: historical
- Evidence type: other — event recap
- Confidence: 65%
- Confidence rationale: A 2017 vendor event recap explicitly describes a partnership with McDonald's Australia lasting more than 45 years. It corroborates longevity and geography but does not name a product or installed scope.
- Source title: Coates X Unstoppable: 2017 McDonald's Owner Operator Convention
- Source URL: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-x-unstoppable-2017-mcdonalds-owner-operator-convention
- Publisher or source owner: Coates Group
- Published date, if known: 2017-11-20
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Coates characterizes its McDonald's Australia relationship as a partnership extending for more than 45 years and reports attending the Australia/New Zealand owner-operator convention.
- Product-specific evidence: None on this page.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Historical and vendor-authored; this page alone cannot establish present-day status or product scope.
- Recommended follow-up: Use the already validated McDonald's ANZ case study for product scope and retain this page only as historical relationship corroboration.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: The 2018 McDonald's Worldwide Convention page might establish a deployed Coates product.
- Pages checked: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-x-mcdonalds-worldwide-convention
- Result: The page says Coates was invited to showcase technology to McDonald's corporate representatives, owner-operators, and suppliers, but it does not identify the technology or assert a purchase, installation, or deployment. Treat it as relationship context, not customer-product evidence.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-group-receives-mcdonalds-chinas-highest-supplier-recognition | supplier award / vendor news | 2026-09-21 | 1 | Current China supplier evidence; exact product estate is unspecified. |
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/mcdonalds-kick-off-meeting-2019 | event recap | 2026-09-21 | 2 | Product-specific event display, not deployment proof. |
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-x-mcdonalds-worldwide-convention | event recap | 2026-09-21 | none | Invited technology showcase only; no product or deployment detail. |
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/coates-x-unstoppable-2017-mcdonalds-owner-operator-convention | event recap | 2026-09-21 | 3 | Historical Australia partnership corroboration; product unspecified. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: The combination of the 2026 China supplier award and older regional event evidence supports a genuinely multi-market McDonald's relationship, but geography and product scope must stay attached to each observation.
- Inference: Event participation is useful relationship context and candidate validation, but it should not be promoted into installed-base evidence without a case study, deployment announcement, or customer-controlled source.
